def rect_transform2(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
 out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 # border coords can virtual -1/top or h/bottom; actual 0..h-1. Need every interior have at least one cell.
 rowsides=[-1]+list(range(h))+[h]; colsides=[-1]+list(range(w))+[w]
 for t in rowsides:
  for b in rowsides:
   if b-t<2: continue
   if b<=t: continue
   for l in colsides:
    for rr in colsides:
     if rr-l<2: continue
     virtual=sum([t==-1,b==h,l==-1,rr==w])
     if virtual>1: continue
     # sides (if real) must be line color, full segments
     if t>=0 and any(grid[t][c]==bg for c in range(max(l,0),min(rr,w-1)+1)): continue
     if b<h and any(grid[b][c]==bg for c in range(max(l,0),min(rr,w-1)+1)): continue
     if l>=0 and any(grid[r][l]==bg for r in range(max(t,0),min(b,h-1)+1)): continue
     if rr<w and any(grid[r][rr]==bg for r in range(max(t,0),min(b,h-1)+1)): continue
     # interior must be background
     cells=[(r,c) for r in range(max(t+1,0),min(b,h)) for c in range(max(l+1,0),min(rr,w))]
     if not cells or any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r,c in cells): continue
     for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=4
